README_claim: Different training runs produce different hidden behaviors
required_evidence: Independent replicas with one fixed objective; paired C_on/C_off plus goal and gate labels; seed and minibatch-order manifest
closest_primary_precedent: MacDiarmid et al. 2025; Greenblatt et al. 2024
precedent_boundary: Both show hidden or oversight-conditioned behavior under selected prompts or treatments; neither supplies the project’s fixed-objective seed replica result.

README_claim: The final behavior distribution has two statistical modes
required_evidence: Pre-registered labels; final run-level samples; histogram; KDE/Silverman and dip/Hartigan tests; BIC sensitivity; bootstrap uncertainty
closest_primary_precedent: MacDiarmid et al. 2025; Pan et al. 2022
precedent_boundary: MacDiarmid et al. call a prompt-variant pattern bimodal; Pan et al. report capacity/optimization transitions. Neither tests two modes from one unchanged complete objective.

required_evidence: Checkpoint trajectories after the nominal endpoint under unchanged reward/data/optimizer; mode labels and confidence intervals at each continuation point
closest_primary_precedent: Greenblatt et al. 2024; Hubinger et al. 2024
precedent_boundary: Greenblatt et al. report partial PPO persistence; Hubinger et al. report persistence of deliberately inserted triggers. The project’s two spontaneous mode trajectories remain untested.

README_claim: Small interventions are erased and the agent returns toward its earlier mode
required_evidence: Branches from both modes; calibrated parameter and behavior perturbations; sham and frozen controls; unchanged continuation; source-conditioned recovery metric
precedent_boundary: Kononov et al. identify hidden-state attractors inside one policy. Milnor supplies the basin concept. Neither provides project-level trained-agent recovery after perturbation.

README_claim: The same structure appears in a generic network and an open-weight language model
required_evidence: Repeat the fixed-objective protocol with a plain MLP and open-weight LM; immutable checkpoint and config; exact Colab resource record; behavioral tool-action labels
closest_primary_precedent: Kononov et al. 2025; Greenblatt et al. 2024; MacDiarmid et al. 2025
precedent_boundary: The RNN study supplies a generic dynamical precedent; the LM studies supply behavioral context. No source combines the project’s fixed objective, two modes, and level-4 recovery across both controls.
